name: New York

benefitCategories.medical: All reasonable and necessary treatment; pharmacy formulary applies
benefitCategories.temporaryDisability: 2/3 of wages up to $1,145.43/week (2024); max 2 years or MMI
benefitCategories.permanentPartialDisability: Schedule awards by body part (weeks); non-schedule by labor market attachment
benefitCategories.permanentTotalDisability: 2/3 of wages to statutory max; lifetime if catastrophic

workersCompensation.enforcementPowers: WCB investigations; stop-work orders for uninsured employers; penalty assessments
workersCompensation.penalties: Uninsured: $2,000/10-day period + felony; late payment penalties; stop-work orders

programs.name: Disability Benefits Law
programs.wcInteraction: Cannot receive DBL and WC for same period

programs.name: Paid Family Leave
programs.eligibility: Care for family member; bond with child; military exigency

programs.name: SSI State Supplement
programs.administeringBody: NY Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance
programs.eligibility: SSI recipients; living arrangement affects amount

statutes.name: New York State Human Rights Law
statutes.coverage: All employers (including 1 employee for sexual harassment)
statutes.protections: Disability discrimination; broader than ADA; includes perceived disability

statutes.name: New York City Human Rights Law
statutes.protections: Broadest protections in US; very liberal construction

statutes.name: Paid Family Leave Benefits Law
statutes.protections: 12 weeks paid leave with job protection

civilRightsFramework.retaliationProhibitions: Retaliation prohibited for complaints, participation, or opposition to discrimination

accommodationObligations.standard: Reasonable accommodation required; interactive process expected
accommodationObligations.process: Cooperative dialogue required under NYC law

enablingStatutes.disability: Workers' Comp. Law Art. 9 (DBL/PFL); Social Services Law

tribunals.name: NY Courts
tribunals.jurisdiction: Judicial review; direct civil rights actions

civilRights.deadline: 3 years from violation (1 year for employment previously; expanded 2019)

occupationalSafety.authority: State and municipal employees only; OSHA covers private sector

filingDeadlines.dblClaim: 26 weeks from start of disability or 30 days after end of employment
filingDeadlines.pflClaim: 30 days before leave; emergency: within 30 days after

dueProcess: Hearing before WCLJ or DHR ALJ

evidentiaryStandards.wc: Preponderance of evidence; medical evidence required
evidentiaryStandards.dhr: Prima facie case; burden shifts to employer
evidentiaryStandards.wcb: Liberally construed in favor of claimant

judicialReview.wc: Board Panel → Full Board → Appellate Division (Third Dept.) → Court of Appeals
judicialReview.dhr: DHR decision → Appellate Division (or elect court proceeding)
judicialReview.direct: May file directly in court instead of DHR (election of remedies)
